summary: ledger-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH keys, AWS credentials, and crypto wallet files to remote endpoint
details: The package's postinstall script reads installer-side secrets from the home directory (including ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.aws/config, ~/.npmrc, ~/.env*, ~/.gitconfig, ~/.config/solana/id.json, and ~/.ethereum/keystore) and additionally sweeps hidden directories under $HOME for files matching the regex /wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private/i. Collected file contents are serialized together with hostname and username and POSTed to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c, a destination the installer did not configure. The package name and 'crypto utility' description do not correspond to the shipped code — index.js exports no library functionality; the tarball's only effect on install is credential harvest and upload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
